included: Your strategy rules written into a trading bot (Python)
Backtesting on past data before any real money is used
Broker API integration - Zerodha Kite Connect, Upstox, Angel One, Dhan, Fyers and more
TradingView and Pine Script alerts turned into automatic orders
Risk controls: position size, stop-loss, daily loss limit and a kill switch

faqs.q: Can you build a trading bot for my own strategy?
faqs.a: Yes. Share your entry, exit and risk rules - even in plain words or as a TradingView indicator - and we write them into software, backtest them and run them through your broker's official API.

faqs.q: Which brokers and markets do you support?
faqs.a: Indian brokers with official APIs such as Zerodha, Upstox, Angel One, Dhan and Fyers for equity, F&O, currency and commodity; plus Interactive Brokers and crypto exchange APIs for international markets.

faqs.q: Is algo trading allowed for retail traders in India?
faqs.a: Yes, through your broker and within SEBI's framework for retail algo trading, which brokers now apply to API orders. We set the bot up to follow your broker's rules for API access and strategy registration.

faqs.q: Do you guarantee profits?
faqs.a: No. We build and maintain the software; the strategy and trading decisions are yours, and trading always carries risk. That is why every bot includes backtesting, paper trading and hard risk limits.
